content.stem: 以下哪些场景描述了合法货币服务企业(MSB)经营者的常见洗钱风险指标？(选择三项。)

options.A: 一位顾客将多张大面额钞票换成小面额钞票。
options.B: 同一天内，一名客户在同一家货币服务企业（MSB）的多个分支机构进行现金交易。
options.C: 客户与汇款目的地存在亲属关系。
options.D: 客户在大致相同的时间以相等的金额进行汇款和收款。
options.E: 一位客户只想与货币服务企业（MSB）的某位特定员工打交道。

content.stem_en: Which of the following scenarios describe common risk indicators of money laundering faced by operators of legitimate money services businesses (MSBs)? (Select Three.)

options_en.A: A customer changes multiple high-denomination notes to low-denomination notes.
options_en.B: A customer conducts cash transactions using multiple branches of the MSB on the same day.
options_en.C: A customer has a family link to the destination of a money transfer.
options_en.D: A customer sends and receives money transfers in equal amounts at or about the same time.
options_en.E: A customer wants to deal only with a particular employee of the money services business (MSB).
